game.name: [🥚 EGG ISLAND] Sell Water!
game.description:
[🥚 EGG ISLAND] Sell Water!

Place Vending Machines! Sell water! Get rich!

🆕 UPDATE: EGG ISLAND!
🥚 Cross the bridge to 9 biomes and steal eggs from the nests
🐔 Every biome has a guard, Chicken to T-Rex, and it WILL chase you
🏃 Train Speed on your treadmill to outrun the guards
🐣 Get home and your egg hatches into a surprise machine
👋 Slap an egg carrier with the bat and the egg goes back
🌋 Rebirth to unlock the far biomes and their rarest eggs

🥷 Steal machines from other factories and run them home
🔒 Lock your factory to keep raiders out
😜 Taunt other players with emotes (press T)
👑 The #1 player becomes a golden statue
🌊 WATER RUSH and MEGA RUSH events

🐄 Give thirsty animals water for cash
🎁 Daily gifts, streaks and fast rebirths

🥤 15 machines, Basic to INFINITY
⭐ Merge two of a kind, a 5⭐ machine earns 700x
🏗️ Belts, collectors and upgraders
🧪 Potions for luck, earnings and speed
🎟️ Code RELEASE! for a 2x income potion

competitors.name: Sell Water to RULE THE WORLD
